name: Law of Proximity
axiom: Objects positioned close to one another are perceived as a unified conceptual group.
trigger: Form labels look attached to the wrong input, or unrelated actions read as one group because spacing is uniform.

checklist.text: Place labels closer to their own input than to the preceding field (4px vs 24px).
Keep spacing inside a card tighter (8-12px) than spacing between cards (24-32px).
Group a primary action with its explanatory copy inside one layout cluster.

antiPattern.violation: A form uses equal 16px margins everywhere, so each input visually attaches to the label below it.
antiPattern.remediation: Use 4px from label to input and 24px from the input container to the next field label.

academicOrigin.title: Untersuchungen zur Lehre von der Gestalt II
